data.name: Jabeen
data.gender_notes: Jabeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of grace and beauty, like a jasmine flower. The name Jabeen carries the meaning “Jasmine, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Jabeen usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the fragrance of faith and the sweetness of the prophet's companions.
data.etymology: Jabeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jasmine, Fragrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabeen total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: جابین
in_urdu.meaning: جابین کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر شخص

in_hindi.meaning: जाबीन का अर्थ है मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाबीन एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति। यह नाम हिंदी में भी प्रयोग होता है और इसका अर्थ है किसी भी कठिनाई या चुनौती का सामना करने में मजबूत और साहसी होने वाला व्यक्ति।

in_english.name: Jabeen
in_english.meaning: Jabeen means strong and courageous person
in_english.long_meaning: Jabeen is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning strong and courageous person. It is derived from the Arabic root 'j-b-n' which connotes the idea of strength, resilience, and bravery. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with positive personality traits such as courage, determination, and perseverance. Historically, the name Jabeen has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify a person who is steadfast in the face of challenges and adversity.

pronunciation.pashto: جابين د تلفظ دی جے بن

data.cultural_impact: The name Jabeen is believed to have Persian and Arabic origins. In Persian culture, it translates to 'jasmine'. The blossoms of this flower are known for their beautiful and intoxicating fragrance. Jasmine has been used as a symbol of beauty, grace, and sweetness throughout history. The name Jabeen is therefore commonly bestowed upon girls to evoke these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have described the character of a noble woman. He described her as having a gentle temperament, being humble, self-controlled, and having the generous nature of subtlety. The name Jabeen, with its connotations of elegance, grace, and beauty, serves as a reminder to young women to embody these virtues. It is a constant reminder of the importance of inner beauty and refinement, which is highly valued in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Jasmine, Fragrant" symbolizes A woman of grace and beauty, like a jasmine flower.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jabeen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of jasmine, fragrant.

historical_references.reference: Jabeen is mentioned in the book 'The Golden Age of Islam' as a popular name during the Abbasid Caliphate.
